title: Nine fixed profiles show no distinct pre-dip brightening at three known KIC 3542116 dips
abstract: We test nine fixed positive profiles before the known D992, D1176, and D1268 dips of KIC 3542116 in public Kepler release 25 data. No event has a distinct positive response against same-quarter controls. The primary mean over three quarters is 19.7 ppm in raw flux and 14.5 ppm in corrected flux. The joint nine-profile scores are exceeded by 85.3 and 75.3 percent of sampled control combinations. Added common 100-ppm profiles pass the primary threshold in only 31 to 32 percent of combinations. Thus, the test has limited sensitivity to weak scattering. It does not exclude dust or establish a new body. Linear pointing and background fits, baseline checks, source hashes, exact raw files, code, controls, recovery data, a figure, and offline checks are included. The control libraries overlap and do not give survey false-alarm probabilities. No independent telescope confirmation is supplied.
